The other area studied was the city of Somerville. The city of Somerville does not dim their lighting but rather has it on turn on and off with sunrise and sunset. 4.1.2 Dataset Development Three datasets for each city were developed for the project. The first is the vehicle crash dataset, the second is a crime dataset, and the third is a photometric dataset representing the lighting levels on the roadways in the city. The crime and crash datasets were downloaded from public data sources with the cities. The photometric database was measured using a mobile measurement system driven through the cities. 4.1.2.1 City of Cambridge The project team obtained crime data from the Cambridge Police Department and detailed crash data from the Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT). The crash data included information about motor vehicle crashes occurring within the Cambridge city limits between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2019. The original crash data provided by the Cambridge Police Department included 14,410 records. In the original data file, however, crash location 35 information is included in a Location field with text descriptions of where the crash occurred. The Location field also included GPS coordinates for many of the crash records. To enable GIS- based data matching and analysis, the project team extracted the GPS coordinate information from the original location information and mapped the records into a GIS format. The resultant dataset included 10,141 records. The crime data included selected types of crimes such as larceny/theft, motor vehicle-related crimes, and assault in Cambridge with a report date between January 1, 2009, and March 31, 2019. Most crime records included the detailed address where the crime was committed. The project team geocoded the addresses using ArcGIS® and mapped the crimes into a GIS format for data matching and analysis. Among the original 63,864 crime records obtained, the research team was able to map 62,762 records using this process. Note that the crime data included a well-populated report date field but a populated crime time field only for some records.
